correctness.rationale: The proof reduces each support of up to six points by affine rank, determines the complete parity-relation types, and exactly computes every canonical signed third moment. For the rank-three six-point type, four even-parity and four odd-parity Walsh samples together with Parseval force only the spectra with third moment 20 or 30. Rank-four six-circuit values are exactly 21 and 24, hence gap3 and the iff statement. The 7- and 8-point three-cube exceptions are bounded by an exact convex-chord inequality and Parseval/sup-norm. The standalone checker passed 255 full small-cube supports, 1,941 low-cardinality four-cube supports, and 3,003 six-support cases with all normalized signings. No finite testing supplies the all-dimensional conclusion.

value.rationale: A sharply motivated discrete counterpart of the Hardy-Littlewood sign-idempotent problem is classified uniformly in dimension. Six rather than three or four frequencies are necessary over Boolean groups; the iff affine circuit and sign-product criterion reveals the mechanism, the 21-to-24 moment jump is exact, and no lower-dimensional group admits reversal with any support. The precise minimality and geometric classification are not simple renamings of the circle examples.
